visualCharacteristics: Row of small text tab labels with a 1px ink underline on the active/hovered tab over a 1px line rule; one rich-text panel visible below (max-width 720px).
contentPattern: One row per tab: cell 1 = tab label (plain text), cell 2 = tab content (richtext: headings, paragraphs, lists, links, images).
usage: Home page 'Content Shop Insider' section (Brand Book / Latest updates / Coming soon).
reuseGuidance: Use for switching between a few peer content panels. Keep labels short; horizontally scrollable on small screens.
